notes.title: 参与二创活动，赢取女神签名照！
notes.notes:
小红书二创活动

发布梗图、表情包、二创美术画作、视频等等，一切和《女神氪金系统》相关的二创，笔记点赞数大于10个即视作参与活动。
从所有参与符合要求的二创活动中，抽取30名幸运儿，获得随机签名照一张。

特别注意：
在发布内容的同时带上话题 #女神氪金系统+相应内容方向（如#女神氪金系统表情包、#女神氪金系统梗图、#女神氪金系统攻略等），以方便后续奖励评选！
我们会根据笔记的综合互动数据进行最终奖励的评选。
参加活动的二创作品需符合法律和平台规范的相关要求。

活动时间为4月25日游戏上线后至5月8日截止。

预计游戏开奖时间为5月15日。

notes.title: Goddess is on sale！
notes.notes:
After 10 months of planning and production, "Goddess Krypton Gold System" is finally officially launched.
This is a brand new attempt, everyone will play a different way of playing the game, please be gentle...

notes.title: Trial version wishlist event prize draw and trial version removal announcement!
notes.notes:
After the trial version was launched, we received a lot of feedback from players. Therefore, we made drastic optimizations to the game based on the feedback from players, and even made major changes to the gameplay. Therefore, the trial version can no longer represent the gameplay to show players, so we have suspended the trial version.

Thank you for your feedback, we will try our best to make a better game!

The following is the list of user nicknames for the wish list event. We will email you one by one to inform you of the winning notification. Thank you for participating in the event!

Welcome to wait for the next game event!

notes.title: Goddess Krypton Gold System Wishlist Event
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

This time the game launched a trial version, which is also a new attempt
For this reason, we also followed up and launched a trial version event!
This trial version event will draw 30 lucky winners and send out the activation code of the official version. Welcome everyone to sign up!

The details of the event are as follows:

Event time:
February 23, 2025 (after the DEMO is launched)-March 15

The list of winners will be announced:
March 16

How to participate:

1 Add "Goddess Krypton Gold System" to the wish list

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322011/a61ca3f8e5fd5390843e956c154dd779b50929c5.jpg[/img]

2 Leave your email address through the form

Users in mainland China please use [url=https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DS1hDRkJFYUdxZGdJ][u][b]Tencent Form[/b][/u][/url]

Users in other regions please use [url=https://forms.gle/Jd8YJ4Qr9u4uk8Mu8][u][b]Google Form[/b][/u][/url]


Event Rewards:
30 players who participated in the event will be randomly selected to receive the full version of the game key
Note: A random draw will be conducted for all participants in the event

References:
The winning notification will be sent to the email address you submitted in the form
The rewards will be distributed in order after the full version is launched
The winning will not be compensated if the personal information entered in the form is incorrect

The game is still a semi-finished product, and many of them are still relatively simple. Please understand!

Finally, thank all players for their participation and support. I hope to get more player feedback to make the game better and better!

notes.title: "Goddess Krypton Gold System" demo comeing soon！
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
"Goddess Krypton Gold System" has been fully reviewed, and the trial version will be available soon.

Because the game has a certain suspense element, in order to avoid early interpretation, we provide limited playable content in the trial version, and hope to get your understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322011/1357b5ebd7d9b3a63a1652a7710523e5983fe87f.gif[/img]

It should be noted that because the game has not been developed, you may encounter some bugs when playing the trial version. You can inform us of the problem through the community feedback bug activity. We will solve it as soon as we receive it. You can also make some suggestions through the community discussion post or discuss the details of the game with other like-minded people. We will also see the suggestions and optimize the game as soon as possible.
I hope that friends who like this game can add a wish list and find like-minded people in the Q group.

Thank you for your attention to "Goddess Krypton Gold System"!
